name: preserve_electrical_axis
mechanism: Scales the amplitude of secondary ECG leads relative to a primary lead using a consistent axis factor to maintain a physiological electrical axis across all waveform components.

name: stochastic_u_wave_generation
mechanism: Introduces a stochastically generated U-wave following the T-wave to increase physiological diversity in the synthetic ECG signal.
code_snippet: if has_u_wave: lead_I += gaussian_wave(t, beat_t + u_dt, u_sigma, u_amp_I)

name: stochastic_qrs_component_generation
mechanism: Introduces probabilistic thresholds for Q and S wave generation to increase inter-sample morphological diversity and simulate realistic variations in QRS complexes.

name: cardiac_vector_projection_model
mechanism: Calculates multi-lead ECG wave amplitudes by projecting 2D cardiac electrical vectors onto specific lead angles rather than using fixed scalar ratios.
